items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Oh yeah, he could play that drum, because he played with me until I quit.

ctx.x: No, a drummer. I thought he was the one who played violin before or something.

Yeah, he played violin before. That was his first instrument. That's right. He showed his right on that. That was his first instrument. Yeah, I heard of him. Then he went on the drum. Well that's the only instrument he really played, that drum. Oh yeah, he could play that drum, because he played with me until I quit. Yeah, he could play that drum.
Well what kind of drum style did Carter play? Would he play mostly on his snare drum for the whole number, or would he be making explosions everywhere, or would he? No.
